subject: Scheduling: technical deep-dive + security & procurement alignment
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Li <anna@cloudfin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Scheduling: technical deep-dive + security & procurement alignment

Hi Anna — great to connect earlier. Quick recap and proposed next step: we heard that Cloudfin wants a 60-minute technical deep-dive focused on production latency/throughput, SSO and data boundaries, and a short procurement checklist so purchasing can map timing.

Can you confirm the attendee list from your side? From ours I'd like to include Marissa (sales lead), Kimberly (solutions architect), and Sean (procurement) — copying Marissa and Kim for visibility.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue 12/15, 09:00–10:00
- Wed 12/16, 11:00–12:00
- Thu 12/17, 14:00–15:00

Agenda (60m):
- 5m quick objectives & success criteria
- 25m infra / runtime demo (ops + perf counters)
- 15m SSO / data isolation / audit logs review
- 10m procurement / next steps and Q&A

I attached a one-page mutual action plan and our standard security questionnaire to help your team ahead of the meeting. If any of those times work, I'll lock the slot and send an invite with a short pre-read.

Thanks — Logan

--
Logan Wright
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0127
From: Anna Li <anna@cloudfin.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Briggs <t.briggs@cloudfin.com>, security@cloudfin.com
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: technical deep-dive + security & procurement alignment

Thanks, Logan — enjoyed the walkthrough. Attendees from Cloudfin: myself, Tom (infra), and our InfoSec inbox (security@cloudfin.com) who will triage the questionnaire. We also expect procurement (Sasha Morales) to join for the latter part; I can loop her in once we confirm a time.

Of the windows you listed, Wed 12/16 11:00–12:00 PST works best for us. Can you include a brief to outline what infra metrics you'll surface during the demo? That helps Tom prepare any environment notes on his side.

Also, quick ask: does Redwood have an SSO checklist for Okta/SCIM integrations we can review before the meeting?

Best,
Anna

--
Anna Li
Director, Cloud Architecture | Cloudfin Health
anna@cloudfin.com | +1 (212) 444-9002
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Li <anna@cloudfin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 11:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: technical deep-dive + security & procurement alignment

Anna — perfect, Wed 12/16 11:00–12:00 PST is locked. Invite going out in a minute; I added Sean from our procurement team so we can surface timeline and commercial checkpoints.

Two quick attachments are included in the invite: the mutual action plan (one page) and the filled security questionnaire we referenced earlier. For the demo metrics, we'll surface:
- p95/p99 token latency (thin vs batched)
- throughput (tokens/sec) across dedicated and hosted modes
- memory / KV cache hit rates during long-context sessions
- failover behavior and model variant fallback latency

SSO/SCIM notes: we have a two-page checklist for Okta/SCIM and a short SCIM mapping sample — I'll add that to the Drive link on the invite. If Sasha (procurement) wants a pre-read on commercial terms, Sean will cover that during the final 10 minutes.

Attachments referenced in invite: mutual_action_plan_v1.pdf, redwood_security_questionnaire.xlsx, okta_scim_checklist.pdf

On Wed we can also decide if Cloudfin prefers a private deployment (VPC) demo or a Hosted API walkthrough; both are feasible in the same window.

Thanks — Logan

- Sean, please prepare a short commercial timeline (MOU -> PO -> onboarding) and a note on whether we can offer a bridge credit for an initial pilot.
